DVE Verification Pages — Implementation Plan

Architecture, gap analysis, and phased execution strategy for per-DVE public verification UIs served through the KNIRVGATEWAY.

Priority
Critical
Total Files Touched
~18
Estimated Effort
~40 hr
Phases
5

Table of Contents

  1. Target Architecture
  2. Current Status — Gap Analysis
  3. Phase 1 — Wire DVEProxyHandler via Socket
  4. Phase 2 — Gateway Proxy Route for /dve/*
  5. Phase 3 — Frontend: Globe Icon → DVE Verification Iframe
  6. Phase 4 — Public "Initiate Validation" (1 NRN) & Client-Side Minting
  7. Phase 5 — Stub-to-Real Data Wiring & Polish
  8. Key Design Decisions Log
  9. Complete File Manifest

1. Target Architecture

The DVE verification pages live as Go HTML templates served by the KNIRVSERVER backend_server (port 8082 / Unix socket), proxied through the KNIRVGATEWAY (port 8080) for public access. The KNIRVSERVER frontend's DVE workspace panel loads them in an iframe pointed at the gateway URL.

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ ── NEW: DVEProxyHandler ────────────────────────── │ │ │ │ /dve/{dveId} → public_page.gohtml │ │ │ │ /dve/{dveId}/validation → validation_records.gohtml │ │ │ │ /dve/{dveId}/metrics → metrics_panel.gohtml │ │ │ │ /dve/{dveId}/search → search_form.gohtml │ │ │ │ /dve/{dveId}/validate → POST (initiate validation) │ │ │ │ /api/dve/{dveId}/verify-proof → proof verification │ │ │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ │ ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ DVE Manager / ValidationCore / ProofGenerator │ │ │ │ Task allocation, result storage, crypto proofs │ │ │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ VerificationIframeModal │ │ │ │ │ │ src = "http://localhost:8080/dve/{id}" │ │ │ │ │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ Request Flow (end-to-end)

Browser tab / iframe │ GET http://localhost:8080/dve/DVE-abc123 ▼ KNIRVGATEWAY (port 8080) │ Route: "/dve/{dveId}" → newSocketProxy(backend.sock, "http://knirvserver") │ Strips /dve prefix path-mapped to backend ▼ backend_server (Unix socket: backend.sock) │ DVEProxyHandler.handleDVEPublicPage() │ Loads: public_page.gohtml │ ├── validation_records.gohtml (real data from ValidationCore) │ ├── metrics_panel.gohtml (real metrics from DVEManager) │ └── search_form.gohtml (with JS validation initiation) ▼ Rendered HTML │ Client-side JS: │ ├── Wallet connect (ethers.js / web3) │ ├── "Initiate Validation" button │ │ → POST /api/economics/validation/request (costs 1 NRN) │ │ → Signed transaction from user wallet │ │ → Polls for result, displays proof receipt │ └── Live metric updates (polling or SSE)

2. Current Status — Gap Analysis

2.1 What Already Exists ✔

DVEURIRegistry backend/internal/services/dve_uri_registry.go ✔ EXISTS In-memory registry stub with GetByDVEID, Register, Resolve. No persistence.

Economics engine (1 NRN cost pattern) packages/KNIRVGATEWAY/internal/payment/economics.go:27 ✔ EXISTS SkillInvocationCost = 1 NRN. Pattern is ready for a DVEReportCost constant.

Frontend Globe icon button frontend/src/components/dashboard/dve-workspace-panel.tsx:166-172 ✔ EXISTS Toggles ViewportPanel. Currently loads container IP:8080. Needs redirect to gateway.
ViewportPanel (iframe container) frontend/src/components/dashboard/viewport-panel.tsx ✔ EXISTS URL bar + iframe + error handling. Reusable with different default URL.
Payment API (frontend) frontend/src/lib/api.ts:326-396 ✔ EXISTS Stripe/PayPal/blockchain balance functions. No "pay for validation" yet.

2.2 What's Missing ✘

GapSeverityDetails
G1: DVEProxyHandler never wired Critical NewDVEProxyHandler is never called in backend/cmd/backend_server/main.go. All HTML template routes return 404. The file exists in the repo but is dead code.
G2: No gateway proxy route for /dve/* Critical packages/KNIRVGATEWAY/internal/server/server.go has no route for /dve/ prefix. Public users can't reach the DVE pages through the gateway.
G3: Globe icon routes to wrong target Critical Globe icon in dve-workspace-panel.tsx:166 opens ViewportPanel with default URL http://{nodeIp}:8080 (container's raw port, possibly WebGUI). Should load http://localhost:8080/dve/{dveId} (gateway-proxied DVE verification page).
G4: Public pages have stub data High All metrics hardcoded to 0, records array always empty. Handlers don't query ValidationCore or DVEManager for real data.
G5: No "Initiate Validation" for public users High Public page is read-only. No form to request validation, pay 1 NRN, or receive a signed receipt. CreateValidationSession requires auth middleware.
G6: No 1 NRN fee for validation reports High Economics engine has SkillInvocationCost (1 NRN) and ValidationReward (0.2 NRN) but no ValidationReportCost constant. No API handler for charging users.
G7: No client-side web3 wallet integration High No wallet connect modal on the DVE public page, no transaction signing, no payment-flow UI.
G8: DVE URI Registry is stub-only Medium In-memory only, no DB/chaint persistence. GetByDVEID works for registered DVEs only.
G9: Blocking iframe embedding Medium Gateway sets X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN and frame-ancestors 'self'. Iframe from port 8090 (KNIRVSERVER frontend) to port 8080 (gateway) may need CSP update.
G10: No proof verification endpoint Low ProofGenerator.VerifyProof exists but no HTTP endpoint exposes it. Public users can't verify proof strings.

3. Phase 1 — Wire DVEProxyHandler via Socket

1 Critical ~2 hr · 2 files

Initialize the DVEProxyHandler in the backend server's main.go and register its routes so the Go HTML templates become live on the backend server.

Rationale

The handler + templates are fully implemented but never loaded. This is the shortest path from zero to a live HTML page at /dve/{dveId} on the backend server (port 8082 / Unix socket). Phase 2 will expose this through the gateway.

Step 1.1 — Add initialization in main.go

packages/KNIRVSERVER/backend/cmd/backend_server/main.go

Locate the DVE route registration block (~lines 1869-1898, where dveHandlers and dveCreationHandlers are registered). Add:

// ── DVE public proxy pages ────────────────────────────────── dveProxyHandler, err := web.NewDVEProxyHandler( services.NewDVEURIRegistry(cfg.StoragePath, s.chainClient, logger), "backend/templates/dve", logger, ) if err != nil { log.Printf("WARN: failed to init DVE proxy handler: %v", err) } else { dveProxyHandler.RegisterRoutes(s.router) log.Println("DVE public proxy routes configured") }

Step 1.2 — Verify the Router interface

dve_proxy_handlers.go:347-349 defines a local Router interface:

type Router interface { HandleFunc(pattern string, handler http.HandlerFunc) }

The backend server's router (gorilla/mux) satisfies this. mux.Router.HandleFunc signature matches. No adapter needed.

Verification

  1. Restart KNIRVSERVER backend
  2. curl http://localhost:8082/dve/test-dve-123 returns rendered HTML (stub data)
  3. curl http://localhost:8082/dve/test-dve-123/validation returns validation records table
  4. curl http://localhost:8082/dve/test-dve-123/metrics returns metrics sidebar
  5. curl http://localhost:8082/dve/test-dve-123/search?q=test returns search results

4. Phase 2 — Gateway Proxy Route for /dve/*

2 Critical ~1 hr · 2 files

Add a reverse-proxy route on the KNIRVGATEWAY so /dve/{dveId}* requests proxy through to the backend server's Unix socket — following the exact same pattern as /api/v1/, /api/oracle/, etc.

Rationale

The gateway is the public entry point. The backend server listens on an internal Unix socket. The newSocketProxy() function already exists. DVE routes need the same treatment.

Step 2.1 — Add /dve/ proxy route

packages/KNIRVGATEWAY/internal/server/server.go

In setupRoutes(), after the Backend proxy registration (~line 289), add:

// DVE public pages proxy — serve per-DVE verification HTML pages // from the backend_server's DVEProxyHandler via Unix socket. // Routes: /dve/{dveId}, /dve/{dveId}/validation, /dve/{dveId}/metrics, // /dve/{dveId}/search, /dve/{dveId}/validate if s.config.BackendSocketPath != "" { dveProxy := newSocketProxy(s.config.BackendSocketPath, "http://knirvserver") r.PathPrefix("/dve/").Handler(dveProxy) s.logger.Info("DVE public page proxy registered", zap.String("socket", s.config.BackendSocketPath)) } else { s.logger.Warn("DVE public page proxy not configured — /dve/* will not be proxied") }

Important ordering: Register /dve/ before the catch-all / WebGUI SPA handler (~line 618), so the DVE routes take priority over the SPA shell.

Step 2.2 — Update CSP for iframe embedding

packages/KNIRVGATEWAY/internal/server/server.go:809

The gateway's wrapWithSecurityHeaders sets:

w.Header().Set("X-Frame-Options", "SAMEORIGIN") w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", "frame-ancestors 'self' http://localhost:8090")

The KNIRVSERVER frontend (running on port 8090) needs to iframe the gateway's DVE page (port 8080). These headers should allow it. Verify with a real browser test. If blocked:

// Update the CSP to include the gateway-origin for iframe embedding w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", "frame-ancestors 'self' http://localhost:8090 http://localhost:8080")

Verification

  1. Restart KNIRVGATEWAY
  2. curl http://localhost:8080/dve/test-dve-123 returns same HTML as backend (proxied)
  3. Open in browser — page renders with full styling

8. Key Design Decisions Log

DecisionChoiceRationale
Where do DVE HTML pages live? KNIRVSERVER backend_server (Go templates, port 8082 / Unix socket) Already implemented, closest to validation data, no N+1 network hops. Templates render server-side for fast initial load.
How does the public reach them? KNIRVGATEWAY reverse proxy via newSocketProxy(backend.sock) Existing pattern used for all internal services. Zero new infrastructure. Follows /api/v1/, /api/oracle/ precedent.
Globe icon in workspace: new tab or iframe? Iframe (new DVEVerificationIframe component) Preserves workspace context. User can switch between verification panel and other workspace tools. Consistent with existing WebguiIframeModal UX pattern.
How does public user pay 1 NRN? Client-side web3 wallet (MetaMask) sends transaction to reward pool User wants client-side minting. No backend private keys needed. User retains custody. Transaction is verifiable on-chain.
What does the 1 NRN cover? One signed validation report with cryptographic proof (PROOF_V1 format), TEE attestation, and timestamp Aligned with existing SkillInvocationCost pricing. DVE operator earns 0.2 NRN ValidationReward, network retains 0.8 NRN.
How does the DVE page communicate validation results to the workspace? window.postMessage bridge from template JS to parent iframe Cross-origin iframe communication. No WebSocket or polling needed from workspace side. Template already renders JavaScript.
Is the DVE proxy handler auth-protected? Public (no auth for GET pages, POST /validate requires valid signed 1 NRN tx) Publicly verifiable by design. Anyone should be able to view validation records and metrics. Payment verification replaces auth for the write endpoint.
CSP changes needed? Minor update to frame-ancestors directive Gateway currently allows localhost:8090. If proxy routes cause origin mismatch, add localhost:8080 to the CSP.

1. Overview

Each DVE is auto-provisioned with a dedicated KNIRVAGENT supervisor process on DVE creation. This spec extends that architecture so the KNIRVAGENT supervisor can spawn, monitor, and proxy arbitrary inner agent CLI tools (e.g. claude, aider, codex) inside the DVE workspace. 395	    StatusExited  SessionStatus = "exited"
396	)
397	
398	type InnerAgentSession struct {
399	    ID           string
400	    ToolName     string
401	    Cmd          *exec.Cmd
402	    PTY          *os.File       // PTY master fd — write = keystrokes, read = output
403	    Status       SessionStatus
404	    StartedAt    time.Time
405	    WorkspaceDir string
406	    DVEID        string
407	
408	    supervisorLog io.Writer    // written by broadcast(); every byte tee'd here
409	
410	    mu          sync.RWMutex
411	    subscribers []chan []byte  // one channel per active /stream consumer
412	    done        chan struct{}
413	}
414	
415	// Subscribe returns a channel that receives every PTY output chunk.
416	// Closed when the session exits. Caller must drain it.
417	func (s *InnerAgentSession) Subscribe() chan []byte {
418	    ch := make(chan []byte, 256)
419	    s.mu.Lock()
420	    s.subscribers = append(s.subscribers, ch)
421	    s.mu.Unlock()
422	    return ch
423	}
424	
425	func (s *InnerAgentSession) Unsubscribe(ch chan []byte) {
426	    s.mu.Lock()
427	    defer s.mu.Unlock()
428	    for i, sub := range s.subscribers {
429	        if sub == ch {
430	            s.subscribers = append(s.subscribers[:i], s.subscribers[i+1:]...)
431	            return
432	        }
433	    }
434	}
435	
436	// broadcast tees a PTY output chunk: supervisor log + all subscriber channels.
437	func (s *InnerAgentSession) broadcast(chunk []byte) {
438	    s.supervisorLog.Write(chunk)
439	    s.mu.RLock()
440	    defer s.mu.RUnlock()
441	    for _, ch := range s.subscribers {
442	        select {
443	        case ch <- append([]byte(nil), chunk...):
444	        default: // drop if subscriber is slow
445	        }
446	    }
447	}
448	
449	// PumpOutput reads from the PTY master and fans out until the process exits.
450	// Run as a goroutine immediately after Spawn.
451	func (s *InnerAgentSession) PumpOutput() {
452	    buf := make([]byte, 4096)
453	    for {
454	        n, err := s.PTY.Read(buf)
455	        if n > 0 {
456	            s.broadcast(buf[:n])
457	        }
458	        if err != nil { break }
459	    }
460	    s.mu.Lock()
461	    s.Status = StatusExited
462	    for _, ch := range s.subscribers { close(ch) }
463	    s.subscribers = nil
464	    s.mu.Unlock()
465	    close(s.done)
466	}

package inner

import (
    "io"
    "os"
    "os/exec"
    "sync"
    "time"
)

type SessionStatus string

const (
    StatusRunning SessionStatus = "running"
    StatusExited  SessionStatus = "exited"
)

type InnerAgentSession struct {
    ID           string
    ToolName     string
    Cmd          *exec.Cmd
    PTY          *os.File       // PTY master fd — write = keystrokes, read = output
    Status       SessionStatus
    StartedAt    time.Time
    WorkspaceDir string
    DVEID        string

    supervisorLog io.Writer    // written by broadcast(); every byte tee'd here

    mu          sync.RWMutex
    subscribers []chan []byte  // one channel per active /stream consumer
    done        chan struct{}
}

// Subscribe returns a channel that receives every PTY output chunk.
// Closed when the session exits. Caller must drain it.
func (s *InnerAgentSession) Subscribe() chan []byte {
    ch := make(chan []byte, 256)
    s.mu.Lock()
    s.subscribers = append(s.subscribers, ch)
    s.mu.Unlock()
    return ch
}

func (s *InnerAgentSession) Unsubscribe(ch chan []byte) {
    s.mu.Lock()
    defer s.mu.Unlock()
    for i, sub := range s.subscribers {
        if sub == ch {
            s.subscribers = append(s.subscribers[:i], s.subscribers[i+1:]...)
            return
        }
    }
}

// broadcast tees a PTY output chunk: supervisor log + all subscriber channels.
func (s *InnerAgentSession) broadcast(chunk []byte) {
    s.supervisorLog.Write(chunk)
    s.mu.RLock()
    defer s.mu.RUnlock()
    for _, ch := range s.subscribers {
        select {
        case ch <- append([]byte(nil), chunk...):
        default: // drop if subscriber is slow
        }
    }
}

// PumpOutput reads from the PTY master and fans out until the process exits.
// Run as a goroutine immediately after Spawn.
func (s *InnerAgentSession) PumpOutput() {
    buf := make([]byte, 4096)
    for {
        n, err := s.PTY.Read(buf)
        if n > 0 {
            s.broadcast(buf[:n])
        }
        if err != nil { break }
    }
    s.mu.Lock()
    s.Status = StatusExited
    for _, ch := range s.subscribers { close(ch) }
    s.subscribers = nil
    s.mu.Unlock()
    close(s.done)
}

package inner

import (
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "sync"
    "time"

    "github.com/creack/pty"
    "github.com/google/uuid"
)

type InnerAgentManager struct {
    mu           sync.RWMutex
    sessions     map[string]*InnerAgentSession
    catalog      *ToolCatalog
    workspaceDir string
    dveID        string
    logDir       string  // {workspaceDir}/.supervisor-logs/
}

func NewInnerAgentManager(dveID, workspaceDir string) *InnerAgentManager {
    logDir := workspaceDir + "/.supervisor-logs"
    os.MkdirAll(logDir, 0755)
    return &InnerAgentManager{
        sessions:     make(map[string]*InnerAgentSession),
        catalog:      DefaultCatalog(),
        workspaceDir: workspaceDir,
        dveID:        dveID,
        logDir:       logDir,
    }
}

// Spawn launches an inner agent CLI tool with a PTY, wires supervisor tee, starts output pump.
func (m *InnerAgentManager) Spawn(toolName string, extraEnv []string) (*InnerAgentSession, error) {
    tool, ok := m.catalog.Lookup(toolName)
    if !ok {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown tool: %s", toolName)
    }
    if !tool.IsInstalled() {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("tool %s not installed; call Install first", toolName)
    }

    sessionID := uuid.NewString()
    logFile, err := os.Create(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s.log", m.logDir, sessionID))
    if err != nil { return nil, err }

    cmd := tool.BuildCmd(m.workspaceDir, extraEnv)
    DefaultSpawnHooks(cmd, m.dveID, sessionID)

    ptmx, err := pty.Start(cmd)
    if err != nil { logFile.Close(); return nil, fmt.Errorf("pty.Start: %w", err) }

    sess := &InnerAgentSession{
        ID:            sessionID,
        ToolName:      toolName,
        Cmd:           cmd,
        PTY:           ptmx,
        Status:        StatusRunning,
        StartedAt:     time.Now(),
        WorkspaceDir:  m.workspaceDir,
        DVEID:         m.dveID,
        supervisorLog: logFile,
        done:          make(chan struct{}),
    }

    m.mu.Lock()
    m.sessions[sessionID] = sess
    m.mu.Unlock()

    go sess.PumpOutput()
    return sess, nil
}

// SendInput writes raw bytes (keystrokes) to the session's PTY master.
func (m *InnerAgentManager) SendInput(sessionID string, data []byte) error {
    sess := m.get(sessionID)
    if sess == nil { return fmt.Errorf("session %s not found", sessionID) }
    _, err := sess.PTY.Write(data)
    return err
}

// Install runs the tool's install command inside the DVE workspace directory.
func (m *InnerAgentManager) Install(toolName string) error {
    tool, ok := m.catalog.Lookup(toolName)
    if !ok { return fmt.Errorf("unknown tool: %s", toolName) }
    return tool.Install(m.workspaceDir)
}

func (m *InnerAgentManager) Terminate(sessionID string) error {
    sess := m.get(sessionID)
    if sess == nil { return nil }
    if sess.Cmd != nil && sess.Cmd.Process != nil {
        sess.Cmd.Process.Kill()
    }
    sess.PTY.Close()
    m.mu.Lock()
    delete(m.sessions, sessionID)
    m.mu.Unlock()
    return nil
}

func (m *InnerAgentManager) GetSession(id string) (*InnerAgentSession, error) {
    sess := m.get(id)
    if sess == nil { return nil, fmt.Errorf("session %s not found", id) }
    return sess, nil
}

func (m *InnerAgentManager) ListSessions() []*InnerAgentSession {
    m.mu.RLock()
    defer m.mu.RUnlock()
    out := make([]*InnerAgentSession, 0, len(m.sessions))
    for _, s := range m.sessions { out = append(out, s) }
    return out
}

func (m *InnerAgentManager) ListTools() []Tool { return m.catalog.All() }

func (m *InnerAgentManager) get(id string) *InnerAgentSession {
    m.mu.RLock()
    defer m.mu.RUnlock()
    return m.sessions[id]
}

// Route registered in api_router.go:
// r.HandleFunc("/ws/dve/{nodeId}/inner/{sessionId}", innerWSHandler.HandleWebSocket)

func (h *DVEInnerAgentWSHandler) HandleWebSocket(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    vars := mux.Vars(r)
    nodeID, sessionID := vars["nodeId"], vars["sessionId"]

    if _, err := h.agentManager.GetSocketPathForDVE(nodeID); err != nil {
        http.Error(w, "no agent for DVE", http.StatusNotFound); return
    }

    conn, err := upgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)
    if err != nil { return }
    defer conn.Close()

    streamCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(r.Context())
    defer cancel()

    stream, err := h.agentManager.GetInnerSessionStream(streamCtx, nodeID, sessionID)
    if err != nil {
        conn.WriteJSON(map[string]string{"type": "error", "data": err.Error()})
        return
    }
    defer stream.Close()

    // goroutine: PTY stream → WebSocket send
    go func() {
        buf := make([]byte, 4096)
        for {
            n, err := stream.Read(buf)
            if n > 0 {
                conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
                conn.WriteJSON(map[string]string{"type": "data", "data": string(buf[:n])})
            }
            if err != nil { cancel(); return }
        }
    }()

    // main loop: browser input → SendInnerInput
    for {
        _, raw, err := conn.ReadMessage()
        if err != nil { break }
        var msg struct{ Type, Data string }
        if json.Unmarshal(raw, &msg) == nil && msg.Type == "input" {
            inputCtx, c := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
            h.agentManager.SendInnerInput(inputCtx, nodeID, sessionID, []byte(msg.Data))
            c()
        }
    }

8. KNIRVGATEWAY Changes

Critical Pre-Requisite — WebSocket Proxy Gap

packages/KNIRVGATEWAY/internal/server/server.go proxies /api/v1/* to backend.sock but has no rule for /ws/*. Browser WebSocket connections to wss://host:8888/ws/dve/{nodeId}/agent (supervisor) and the new wss://host:8888/ws/dve/{nodeId}/inner/{sessionId} are silently dropped. This must be fixed first.

packages/KNIRVGATEWAY/internal/server/server.go MODIFIED

Standard httputil.ReverseProxy strips Upgrade and Connection headers, breaking WebSockets. The fix uses raw TCP hijacking to tunnel the WebSocket framing through the Unix socket without modification. 

// In setupRoutes() — AFTER the existing /api/v1/ proxy rule:

// ── existing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
backendProxy := newSocketProxy(cfg.BackendSocketPath, "")
r.PathPrefix("/api/v1/").Handler(backendProxy)

// ── ADD: WebSocket tunnel to backend.sock ─────────────────────────────────
// httputil.ReverseProxy cannot handle WebSocket upgrades — use raw TCP tunnel.
r.PathPrefix("/ws/").HandlerFunc(newWebSocketTunnel(cfg.BackendSocketPath))

// ── new helper function to add to server.go ───────────────────────────────
func newWebSocketTunnel(socketPath string) http.HandlerFunc {
    return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        backendConn, err := net.Dial("unix", socketPath)
        if err != nil {
            http.Error(w, "backend unavailable", http.StatusBadGateway)
            return
        }
        defer backendConn.Close()

        hijacker, ok := w.(http.Hijacker)
        if !ok { http.Error(w, "hijacking not supported", http.StatusInternalServerError); return }
        clientConn, buf, err := hijacker.Hijack()
        if err != nil { return }
        defer clientConn.Close()

        // Replay the original HTTP request to the backend.
        r.Write(backendConn)
        if n := buf.Reader().Buffered(); n > 0 {
            io.CopyN(backendConn, buf, int64(n))
        }

        // Bidirectional copy — both sides run concurrently; first done cancels both.
        done := make(chan struct{}, 2)
        go func() { io.Copy(backendConn, clientConn); done <- struct{}{}{}() }()
        go func() { io.Copy(clientConn, backendConn); done <- struct{}{}{}() }()
        <-done
    }
}

InnerAgentTerminal Behaviors

  • xterm.js in raw mode — no line buffering. Inner CLI tools handle echo themselves.
  • On mount: open WebSocket → stream output to terminal.write(data).
  • Keystrokes: sent one character at a time as {"type":"input","data":"k"}.
  • On tab close: DELETE /api/v1/dve/{id}/inner/{sid} then disconnect WS.
  • Terminal resize: send {"type":"resize","cols":N,"rows":N} — KNIRVAGENT calls pty.Setsize().

10. Complete Data Flow

10.1 Spawn Inner Agent Session

1
User clicks "+" in DVE workspace → ToolPickerModal → selects "claude".
2
If not installed: POST /api/v1/dve/{id}/inner/install → KNIRVGATEWAY tunnel → backend.sock → inner_agent_handlers.go → AgentManager.InstallTool() → POST /api/inner/install on agent-{dveID}.sock → InnerAgentManager.Install("claude") → runs npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code inside DVE workspace.
3
POST /api/v1/dve/{id}/inner/spawn → same path → AgentManager.SpawnInnerSession() → POST /api/inner/spawn on agent-{dveID}.sock → InnerAgentManager.Spawn("claude") → pty.Start(cmd) → goroutine PumpOutput(). Returns {"id":"<sessionID>",...}.
4
Frontend opens new tab with InnerAgentTerminal. Connects WebSocket: wss://host:8888/ws/dve/{id}/inner/{sessionId}.
5
KNIRVGATEWAY newWebSocketTunnel(backend.sock) hijacks the TCP connection and pipes raw bytes to backend.sock.
6
DVEInnerAgentWSHandler upgrades WS. Calls AgentManager.GetInnerSessionStream(ctx, dveID, sessionID) → long-lived GET http://localhost/api/inner/{sessionId}/stream on agent-{dveID}.sock.
7
handleStream() in pkg/server/inner_routes.go calls sess.Subscribe() and pumps chunks to the chunked HTTP response. Backend reads chunks and sends to browser as {"type":"data","data":"..."}.
8
User keystrokes → browser → WS → backend → AgentManager.SendInnerInput() → POST /api/inner/{sessionId}/input → InnerAgentManager.SendInput() → sess.PTY.Write(data).

10.2 Supervisor Tee (Monitoring)

  • Every PTY output byte passes through InnerAgentSession.broadcast().
  • Written simultaneously to {workspaceDir}/.supervisor-logs/{sessionID}.log and all subscriber channels.
  • Supervisor can read the log at any time via GET /api/inner/{sid}/log.
  • The supervisor's own /api/execute endpoint (existing) can reference session logs to provide context-aware oversight or intervention.
  • Future: supervisor can inject keystrokes into any inner session's PTY via sess.PTY.Write() — same path as user input, enabling automated correction of misbehaving inner agents.

1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user requested an audit of both codebases against two reference documents (`DVE_PAGES_FIX.html` and `agentic_hierarchy_implementation.html`) and implementation of the identified fixes. Specifically:
   - **DVE Verification Pages**: The user could not see DVE Verification Pages as described in `DVE_PAGES_FIX.html`. These are per-DVE public verification UIs served through KNIRVGATEWAY, displayed via an iframe when clicking the Globe icon in the DVE workspace panel.
   - **Inner Agent Terminal Sessions**: The user could not see a way to spawn new terminal sessions in the DVE Modal, as specified in `agentic_hierarchy_implementation.html` (two-tier supervisor + inner agent architecture with tabs for `claude`, `aider`, `codex`, etc.).

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **KNIRVSERVER architecture**: Top-level gin server that embeds and runs `backend_server` binary as a subprocess via Unix socket; also embeds KNIRVGATEWAY as a subprocess
   - **Template embedding**: Go `//go:embed` for `fs.FS` vs relative path strings — relative paths fail when binary runs from extracted location
   - **DVEProxyHandler**: Go HTML template handler serving `/dve/{dveId}` pages; was using relative template path `"backend/templates/dve"` which breaks at runtime
   - **KNIRVGATEWAY proxy routes**: `newSocketProxy` and `registerGatewayPrefix` patterns for routing through Unix sockets
   - **Inner Agent Hierarchy**: Two-tier architecture where KNIRVAGENT supervisor process can spawn/monitor inner CLI tools (claude, aider, codex) via PTY in separate sessions
   - **Unix socket topology**: All internal communication via Unix sockets; browser → KNIRVSERVER gin → gateway socket → backend socket → agent socket
   - **WebSocket tunneling**: `handleInnerAgentWS` in KNIRVGATEWAY dials agent Unix socket and streams PTY output to browser WebSocket
   - **xterm.js**: Raw PTY mode for inner agent terminals (no line buffering); supervisor uses buffered line mode
   - **Relative API URLs**: Frontend uses `API_BASE_URL = ''` (empty string) so all fetch calls use same origin as page

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`packages/KNIRVSERVER/backend/internal/dvetemplates/dvetemplates.go`** (CREATED)

     ```go
     package dvetemplates
     import "embed"
     //go:embed *.gohtml
     var FS embed.FS
     ```

     - Changed `template.New(...).Funcs(...).ParseGlob(pattern)` to `template.New(...).Funcs(...).ParseFS(tmplFS, "*.gohtml")`
     ```go
     func NewDVEProxyHandler(registry *services.DVEURIRegistry, tmplFS fs.FS, logger *zap.Logger, opts ...DVEProxyHandlerOption) (*DVEProxyHandler, error) {
         funcMap := template.FuncMap{ ... }

         if err != nil {
     ```

     ```go
     if err := registerGatewayPrefix("/dve", "/dve"); err != nil {
     ```

     - This routes `GET /dve/*` from the KNIRVSERVER gin server → KNIRVGATEWAY socket → backend socket → DVEProxyHandler

     - Removed all port scanning logic (`scanForGateway`, `checkHealth`, `cachedGatewayPort`)

     ```typescript
     function buildDvePageUrl(dveId: string): string {

     }
     ```
     - Simplified component state: `dvePageUrl` is now computed directly, not stored in state
     - Removed async URL resolution effect

   - **`packages/KNIRVSERVER/frontend/src/hooks/use-inner-agent.ts`** (CREATED)
     - React hook for inner agent API operations
     - Interfaces: `InnerAgentTool { name, binary, is_installed }`, `InnerAgentSession { id, tool_name, status, started_at }`
     - `useInnerAgent(dveId)` returns: `{ tools, sessions, loading, error, listTools, listSessions, installTool, spawnSession, terminateSession }`
     - API endpoints: `GET /api/v1/dve/{dveId}/inner/tools`, `GET /api/v1/dve/{dveId}/inner/sessions`, `POST /api/v1/dve/{dveId}/inner/install`, `POST /api/v1/dve/{dveId}/inner/spawn`, `DELETE /api/v1/dve/{dveId}/inner/sessions/{sessionId}`

   - **`packages/KNIRVSERVER/frontend/src/components/dashboard/tool-picker-modal.tsx`** (CREATED)

**#6538** 10:49 AM 🔄 **Removed port scanning from DVE verification iframe**

The DVE verification iframe component previously implemented complex port scanning logic to locate the KNIRVGATEWAY across multiple ports (8081, 8080, 8090), caching results and handling async failures. This has been eliminated in favor of relative URLs that leverage the existing KNIRVSERVER proxy architecture. The component now builds URLs as `/dve/{dveId}` which route through the current origin to KNIRVSERVER's /dve/* proxy endpoint, which then forwards to the gateway and backend Unix socket. This eliminates 40+ lines of port discovery code, removes async complexity from component initialization, and aligns with the same-origin proxy pattern used elsewhere in the application.

The console panel component was restructured to support multiple concurrent terminal sessions through a tabbed interface. Both clean. Here's what changed and why:

**Root cause**: The `/api/agent/*` prefix was never registered as a gateway route in KNIRVSERVER. Every request to `/api/agent/...` fell through to the `/api/*path` catch-all, which proxied it to the **backend** socket — not KNIRVGATEWAY. **Fix**:
1. Added `registerGatewayPrefix("/api/agent", "/api/agent")` in `main.go` — gin now has an explicit `/api/agent/*path` route that takes priority over `/api/*path` and proxies straight to KNIRVGATEWAY, which already has `dynamicAgentProxy` wired to route `/api/agent/{dveId}/*` → the per-DVE KNIRVAGENT socket
2. Updated all URLs in `use-inner-agent.ts` from `/api/v1/dve/{id}/inner/*` → `/api/agent/{id}/api/inner/*` to match what KNIRVGATEWAY actually handles

1. **Wrong URLs in hook**: Reverted to `/api/agent/` which points at KNIRVGATEWAY's per-DVE socket path (doesn't exist). Original `/api/v1/dve/{dveId}/inner/*` was correct — the backend already has `InnerAgentHandlers` wired there.

2. **KNIRVAGENT not auto-started**: `HandleSpawn` calls `ForwardToInnerAgent` which fails with 502 if no agent is running for that DVE — but no error reaches the frontend UI so it looks like nothing happened.

Fix both:

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user requested fixes for two features in the KNIRV KNIRVSERVER frontend:
   - **DVE Verification Pages**: Public DVE verification pages served via Go templates should appear in an iframe within the DVE workspace modal (accessed via globe icon)
   - **Inner Agent Terminal**: Clicking "+" in the console panel's tab bar should spawn a new raw bash terminal tab (not a tool picker modal), letting the user install agents themselves
   
   The user also requested removal of the tool picker modal in favor of directly spawning a bash shell.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **KNIRVSERVER architecture**: Gin server (port 8090) that runs backend_server and KNIRVGATEWAY as subprocesses via Unix sockets
   - **Unix socket topology**: browser → KNIRVSERVER gin → gateway socket → backend socket → agent socket
   - **Per-DVE KNIRVAGENT**: Each DVE gets its own KNIRVAGENT subprocess with socket at `/var/lib/knirvserver/sockets/agent-{dveId}.sock`
   - **InnerAgentHandlers**: Backend web handlers at `/api/v1/dve/{dveId}/inner/*` that proxy to KNIRVAGENT via `ForwardToInnerAgent`
   - **DVEInnerAgentWSHandler**: Backend WS handler registered at `/ws/dve/{dveId}/inner/stream/{sessionId}` (note: includes `/dve/` in path)
   - **DVEURIRegistry**: In-memory registry (starts empty, never populated from DB) — must fall back to `dveManager.GetNode()`
   - **Go template embed**: `public_page.gohtml` only contains `{{ define "..." }}` blocks — no root template named "public_page.gohtml" so `ExecuteTemplate` produced empty output
   - **Gin catch-all conflict**: Cannot register `/api/agent/*path` AND `/api/*path` — gin panics with "wildcard conflicts with existing path segment"
   - **AGENT_SOCKET_DIR**: KNIRVGATEWAY's `AgentSocketDir` defaults to `""` since `AGENT_SOCKET_DIR` env var is never passed — gateway cannot find per-DVE sockets

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`packages/KNIRVSERVER/backend/internal/dvetemplates/public_page.gohtml`**
     - Added root template definition at the very top so `ExecuteTemplate(w, "public_page.gohtml", data)` has something to execute
     - Critical fix: without this, the template executed empty content → blank page
     ```
     {{ define "public_page.gohtml" }}{{ template "header" . }}{{ template "content" . }}{{ end }}
     
     {{ define "header" }}
     ...
     ```

   - **`packages/KNIRVSERVER/backend/internal/web/dve_proxy_handlers.go`**
     - Added `resolveDVE()` helper that falls back to `dveManager.GetNode()` when `DVEURIRegistry` is empty
     - All four handlers (`handleDVEPublicPage`, `handleValidationRecords`, `handleDVEMetrics`, `handleSearch`) now use `resolveDVE()` instead of registry directly
     ```go
     func (h *DVEProxyHandler) resolveDVE(dveID string) (*services.DVEURI, error) {
         if dve, err := h.uriRegistry.GetByDVEID(dveID); err == nil {
             return dve, nil
         }
         if h.dveManager == nil {
             return nil, fmt.Errorf("DVE not found: %s", dveID)
         }
         node, err := h.dveManager.GetNode(dveID)
         if err != nil {
             return nil, fmt.Errorf("DVE not found: %s", dveID)
         }
         return &services.DVEURI{
             ID:        node.ID,
             DVEID:     node.ID,
             FullURI:   fmt.Sprintf("knirv://%s", node.ID),
             Status:    node.Status,
             CreatedAt: node.CreatedAt.Unix(),
         }, nil
     }
     ```

   - **`packages/KNIRVAGENT/pkg/inner/catalog.go`**
     - Added `"shell"` tool (bash -i) and guarded `Install()` for empty InstallCmd
     ```go
     func (t *Tool) Install(workdir string) error {
         if len(t.InstallCmd) == 0 {
             return nil
         }
         ...
     }
     
     func DefaultCatalog() *ToolCatalog {
         return &ToolCatalog{tools: map[string]*Tool{
             "shell": {Name: "shell", Binary: "bash", DefaultArgs: []string{"-i"}, InstallCmd: []string{}},
             "claude": ...
     ```

   - **`packages/KNIRVSERVER/frontend/src/hooks/use-inner-agent.ts`**
     - Currently uses `/api/v1/dve/${dveId}/inner/*` URLs (reverted back from incorrect `/api/agent/` URLs)
     - These are the correct URLs — backend `InnerAgentHandlers` handles them via `ForwardToInnerAgent`
     ```typescript
     const resp = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/dve/${dveId}/inner/spawn`, {
         method: 'POST',
         headers: getAuthHeaders(),
         body: JSON.stringify({ tool: toolName }),
     });
     const data = await resp.json();
     const sessionId: string = data.id ?? data.session_id;
     return sessionId ?? null;
     ```

   - **`packages/KNIRVSERVER/frontend/src/components/dashboard/console-panel.tsx`**
     - Removed `ToolPickerModal`, added `useInnerAgent(nodeId)` hook
     - "+" button directly calls `spawnSession('shell')` and adds a tab
     ```tsx
     onClick={async () => {
         const sessionId = await spawnSession('shell');
         if (sessionId) {
             const label = `Terminal ${innerSessions.length + 1}`;
             setInnerSessions(prev => [...prev, { sessionId, toolName: label }]);
             setActiveTab(sessionId);
         }
     }}
     ```

   - **`packages/KNIRVSERVER/frontend/src/components/dashboard/inner-agent-terminal.tsx`**
     - Connects WS to: `ws://host/ws/${dveId}/inner/stream/${sessionId}` (WITHOUT `/dve/` in path)
     - This is a **mismatch** — backend handler is at `/ws/dve/{dveId}/inner/stream/{sessionId}`

   - **`packages/KNIRVSERVER/main.go`**
     - Has `/dve` gateway prefix (correct)
     - Has inline `/api/agent/` detection in `/api/*path` handler (forwards to gateway)
     - wsHandler routes `/inner/` paths to gateway — but gateway can't find socket (AGENT_SOCKET_DIR empty)
     ```go
     if strings.HasPrefix(c.Request.URL.Path, "/api/agent/") {
         agentProxy, agentErr := newPrefixProxy(gatewayBase, gatewayTransport, "", "")
         if agentErr == nil {
             agentProxy.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
             return
         }
     }
     ```
     ```go
     wsHandler := func(c *gin.Context) {
         if strings.Contains(c.Request.URL.Path, "/inner/") {
             gatewayWSProxy.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
             return
         }
         wsProxy.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
     }
     ```

All four fixes are in and everything compiles. Here's what changed:

**`use-inner-agent.ts`** — replaced `resp.json()` with `resp.text()` + `JSON.parse()` so any parse failure produces a visible error message instead of being silently swallowed in the catch block. Also tightened the null check on `sessionId`.

**`console-panel.tsx`** — exposed `error` from `useInnerAgent` and added a red error label in the tab bar that appears when spawn returns null. Click `+` and if something goes wrong you'll now see the reason inline.

**`inner-agent-terminal.tsx`** — fixed the WebSocket URL from `/ws/${dveId}/inner/stream/${sessionId}` to `/ws/dve/${dveId}/inner/stream/${sessionId}` to match the backend handler registration at `/ws/dve/{dveId}/inner/stream/{sessionId}`.

**`main.go`** — removed the broken gateway WS proxy branch. All `/ws/*` paths now route to the backend socket, which has `DVEInnerAgentWSHandler` registered and connects directly to per-DVE KNIRVAGENT sockets — no `AGENT_SOCKET_DIR` needed.

Restart KNIRVSERVER and click `+` in the terminal tab area. If spawn still fails, a red error message will appear in the tab bar telling you exactly why (e.g. `Spawn failed (500): tool shell not installed` or `Invalid spawn response: ...`). That will pinpoint whether the issue is in the agent, the socket, or the response format.

content.text:
Binary is built and ready. Restart KNIRVSERVER — if you're running it directly, replace the binary:

```bash
sudo systemctl stop knirvserver   # or however you run it
cp /tmp/knirv-server-ready /usr/local/bin/knirv-server   # or your install path
sudo systemctl start knirvserver
```

Or if running in dev mode from the repo directory:

```bash
cd packages/KNIRVSERVER
go run . --config config/development.yaml
```

**What this round of fixes resolved:**

- **502 on spawn** — `GetSocketPath` now falls back to scanning the socket directory on disk (`/var/lib/knirvserver/sockets/agent-{dveId}.sock`) when the agent isn't in the in-memory map (happens after a KNIRVSERVER restart while KNIRVAGENT is still running). The re-discovered agent is registered and marked healthy so future calls use the fast path.
- **Tab didn't appear** — error state was being set silently inside `useInnerAgent` with no way to see it. Now if anything goes wrong you'll see a red inline message in the tab bar (e.g. `Spawn failed (502): no agent running for DVE ...`).
- **WS terminal blank** — URL was `/ws/{dveId}/inner/...` but the handler is at `/ws/dve/{dveId}/inner/...`. Fixed.
- **WS routing wrong** — `/inner/` paths were going to the gateway (which had no socket dir). All WS paths now go to the backend socket where `DVEInnerAgentWSHandler` lives.

content.text:
New binary is ~200 bytes larger (our extra code). Install it and restart the DVE agent:

```bash
# Stop the running KNIRVAGENT for this DVE
sudo kill 2093579

# Install the new binary
sudo cp /tmp/knirvagent-new /var/lib/knirvserver/bin/knirvagent

# KNIRVSERVER will restart the agent when you next open a DVE workspace
# OR restart KNIRVSERVER to pick up the new backend+frontend too:
sudo systemctl restart knirvserver   # or however you run it
```

**What was wrong:**

1. **`EPERM` on `fork/exec /usr/bin/bash`** — The `Spawn` method set `SysProcAttr.Setpgid = true` before calling `pty.Start`. Internally, `pty.Start` sets `Setsid = true`, which makes the child process a session leader. POSIX/Linux forbids a session leader from calling `setpgid`, so the child got EPERM from `setpgid` before even reaching `exec`. Removed the `Setpgid` — `pty.Start`'s `Setsid` already puts the process in its own group.

2. **Wrong workspace directory** — `filepath.Dir(socketPath)` resolved to the sockets directory (`/var/lib/knirvserver/sockets/`). Changed to derive the data root one level up and use `workspaces/{dveID}/` instead.

content.text:
The fix is in `/tmp/knirvserver-new`. Deploy it the same way as before:

```bash
sudo cp /tmp/knirvserver-new /usr/local/bin/knirvserver  # or wherever it lives
sudo systemctl restart knirvserver
```

The root cause was `http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}` in `InnerAgentClient` — that timeout applies to the entire request lifecycle including reading the response body, so when bash went idle at the prompt the streaming HTTP connection was killed after 30 seconds. The fix uses a no-timeout clone of the client (`&http.Client{Transport: client.Transport}`) only for `streamSession`, preserving the 30 s timeout for the short-lived `forwardInput` and `forwardResize` calls.
